text: Fortuna Entertainment Group (FEG) is owned by Penta Investments: Penta's own site calls Penta 'FEG's mother company', and trade press describes FEG as owned by Penta Investments.

source.name: Penta Investments: Fortuna Entertainment Group Expands into Lithuania with Acquisition of TOPsport
source.quote: The transaction marks a record investment for FEG’s mother company, Penta.

additionalSources.name: Gambling News: Penta Investments Reportedly Considers Divesting Fortuna Entertainment
additionalSources.quote: Penta Investments, which owns the betting and gaming powerhouse Fortuna Entertainment Group
additionalSources.note: March 2024 report that Penta was weighing a sale of FEG; no completed sale found, and Penta's own site still describes FEG as its company in 2026.
